verdict.rationale: Rippling docs claim real-time provisioning/deprovisioning of access, groups, and entitlements tied to role changes and federated protocol support including custom SCIM apps, and even claim to eliminate 'SCIM lag' — suggesting push provisioning into downstream apps. However, none of the evidence details a concrete SCIM implementation (attribute mapping, supported SCIM endpoints, per-app provisioning connectors, or entitlement-level granularity) beyond marketing claims. missing for 10: explicit SCIM protocol documentation/spec compliance, list of supported downstream apps via SCIM, entitlement-level provisioning detail, independent/hands-on confirmation of real-time push behavior.
